title: Preparing immune memory
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Vaccination can prime antigen-specific adaptive immune responses and memory. The strength and duration of protection vary by vaccine, person and pathogen.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: A vaccine presents an antigen or instructions to make one. What adaptive response can this help establish? Vaccination can prime antigen-specific adaptive immune responses and memory. The strength and duration of protection vary by vaccine, person and pathogen.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: What can vaccination help prime in adaptive immunity? Vaccination can prime antigen-specific immune memory, with protection varying by context.

options: A new kind of red blood cell
